# TfS PCF Data Model 3.1.0 — generated, do not edit

Source: TfS PCF Data Model: How to report PCF data, Version 3.1, September 2025 (131 numbered rows, pp. 3-15).

TfS publishes this data model as a PDF table, not as a SAMM model, so no
`.ttl` exists. Both files in `gen/` are generated by
`scripts/tfs_pcf/generate.py` in
`cx_semantic_aspect_models_versioning_service`
from `scripts/tfs_pcf/catalogue/3.1.0.json`. Edit the
catalogue and re-run the script; hand edits here are lost on the next run.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Catalogue URN (minted by the versioning service) | `urn:samm:io.tfs.pcf:3.1.0#TfsPcf` |
| TfS identifier (`nativeId`, `specVersion`) | `urn:tfs-initiative.com:datamodel-version:3.1.0` |
| Groups (PDF headlines and object arrays) | 26 |
| Leaf fields | 105 |
| Conditional rules | R1, R2, R3, R4, R5 |

The example payload `gen/TfsPcf.json` is built from the PDF sample values
with units stripped, and validates against `gen/TfsPcf-schema.json`.

## Where the example departs from the PDF samples

| Row | Field | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | `companyAndProductInformation.companyInformation.companyIds` | PDF sample list shortened to two entries and its line-break spaces removed. |
| 10 | `companyAndProductInformation.productInformation.productIds` | PDF sample list shortened to two entries and its line-break spaces removed. |
| 76 | `general.comment` | The PDF gives no sample; this one is the Catena-X PCF 9.0.0 example text. |
